## PUBLIC HANDOFF · STOP C · sole Track P #1786

[Draft #1789](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/pull/1789) is open to `main` from `refs/heads/p1786-displaced-mode-handoff`. Public HEAD `bcc0592fe95f4518c608f8e9dc54ca0090ee70ad`, tree `991cf3f079e69ae99342c45251200b1a015b6147`, sole parent and actual main `637653d917d1bc63acece382f0e014df3ae19e02` (Draft17.38) match the fixed release. All 12 paths and recorded public blobs match the local diff. Full-index binary diff 23,026 bytes, SHA-256 `fb6a10f927be072fcac11dbc55f1be361913bdfc7eeb863fdb14e42f3cac691e`. GitHub synthetic `refs/pull/1789/merge` is `d8e53b50d0ad3ce5a3ca10c79f2ac97cf5c9f518`, ordered parents `[637653d917d1bc63acece382f0e014df3ae19e02, bcc0592fe95f4518c608f8e9dc54ca0090ee70ad]`, same tree and byte-identical diff. [Exact C release](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1786#issuecomment-7158365499).

**Supported source.** Two independent live originals use the same registered scoped writer on the same field index. Once the first loan is closed, an explicit named ordinary Copy of its displaced byte supplies the second writer's actual on the other original. The matching returned value and incoming binding survive in the exact second replay entry. Named Change result and direct Change tail both pass. The adopted current-field route still copies the updated first original's field and retains its C17 bytes. The literal mode, same-original and single-original controls also retain their C17 bytes. The call replays, separate scopes, whole-entry seal and original cleanup cover both routes.

**Refusal and measured behavior.** The unchanged adopted pin repeated both frozen 11-case matrices. The three displaced examples passed CHECK and first refused at C17 4 there. Integrated GCC Release and Clang ASan/LSan/UBSan pass both matrices. The new positive C17 matches the original private pin byte for byte. Wrong field or original, pre-Change read, unrelated actual and a different Copy with an equal runtime byte remain C17 4 after CHECK. Reference escape remains CHECK 3. Refusals retain existing output bytes and identity, leave absent destinations absent and leave no staging residue.

The local runner passed 160 strict GCC/Clang O0/O2 native runs and twelve sanitized native runs. The current-field route transfers 35 or 93. The displaced route transfers 41 or 57 while the active descriptor ends at 35 or 93 and standby returns its own old 101 or 102. The tests check both original addresses, siblings and ordered loans. GCC Release and Clang ASan/LSan/UBSan each passed four root CTest rollback tests. For the observed and displaced cases, each exercised 1,656 CHECK failures and 16 seal failures. Named C17 covered 2,495 and 2,493 failure positions respectively per destination state. Restoration, both child results, no-clobber and retry passed. The root common 90 s assignment precedes the two individual overrides. #242 current-field and #243 displaced-mode each have effective `TIMEOUT=180`. [Integrated LOCAL READY](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1786#issuecomment-7158334207).

**Natural PR CI.** Each run is event `pull_request`, attempt 1, bound to #1789 and the exact head/base above. At the captured snapshot the ten jobs were in progress. Required is FULL seven and PARTIAL one.

| Run | Jobs |
| --- | --- |
| [FULL 45586558500](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/45586558500/attempts/1) | ASan Heavy `139109535134`, GCC `139109535415`, ASan Light A `139109535416`, Clang `139109535508`, GCC Release `139109535768`, UBSan `139109535786`, ASan Light B `139109535912` |
| [PARTIAL 45586558618](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/45586558618/attempts/1) | Production CHECK + C17/native `139109534741` |
| [EARLY (non-required) 45586558654](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/45586558654/attempts/1) | Early coding GO ASan `139109535453`, Early coding GO UBSan `139109535927` |

All eight actual-main Required jobs completed successfully on `637653d917d1bc63acece382f0e014df3ae19e02`. [Main FULL](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/45582751995/attempts/1) · [Main PARTIAL](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/45582752139/attempts/1).

The original private `67892319bec74115337b4f09daa1cc045af1c4a2`, FIRST, Gate0, first ENOSPC, local raw and both independently restored baseline archives remain attributed. The local publication identity packet has 50 verified members. `PUBLIC-IDENTITY.sha256` is `50a14a73fc7747f1870824aa9769eec705bdb580c947d6633ce7996c7d88a23e`. Independent F/R input exposure is zero. [FIRST](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1786#issuecomment-7157390584) · [Original LOCAL READY](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1786#issuecomment-7157834795) · [Archive verification](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1786#issuecomment-7158057368). **STOP C** for independent release, CI audit, readiness and adoption.
